slides.headline: A DAD TURNED 1 MONTH OF EMPLOYEE WORK INTO 5 MINUTES

caption:
A non-technical dad tried Claude Code for the first time. His employee's month of work took him five minutes. He called his son crying.

THE 5-MINUTE EMPLOYEE RULE.

He used Claude Code, an AI tool that takes a plain-English task description and executes it.

1. MAP IT. Monthly tasks that end in a document or code. Write three. Those are your Claude Code targets.

2. TEST IT. Describe one to Claude Code in plain English. Finishes in under an hour? You found a task that belongs to Claude Code, not your payroll.

3. HOLD THE HIRE. Run it through Claude Code for a week before headcount approval. Two passes, skip the hire. That is roughly one mid-level hire, $80K, $120K a year, depending on your market.

SAVE THIS: the 5-minute employee rule.

When a first-time user outperforms a month of employee work in five minutes, every founder asks the same question: which tasks in my payroll are actually Claude Code sessions? Most businesses have three to five. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll find yours.
